title: bayesaenet: uncertainty quantification for machine learning interatomic potentials
description: Variational Bayesian neural networks (LRT, Radial, Flipout) and deep ensembles for aenet-PyTorch machine learning interatomic potentials, with joint energy+force ELBO training, Optuna hyperparameter search, and uncertainty quantification metrics. Software accompanying the paper doi:10.1088/2632-2153/ae9de8.
